newsitem.title: MEXICO: Liverpool to buy eight Chedraui stores.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool to buy eight Chedraui stores.

text.p: Mexico's El Puerto de Liverpool SA de CV on Monday said it agreed to buy eight Las Galas stores from Grupo Comercial Chedraui for $35.5 million.

The deal gives Liverpool an option to buy a ninth store under construction for an unspecified price. In addition, the department store chain said it would pay $6 million to become the creditor for Chedraui debtors.
Liverpool said in a statement that the deal was subject to approval by Mexican authorities and by the boards of each company.

"This acquisition allows Liverpool to increase its sales area by about 50,000 square meters, which represents 19 percent of its current floor space, and expand its operations into the Gulf of Mexico zone," Enrique Bremond, chairman of the Liverpool board, said in the statement.
Liverpool currently operates 19 stores in major Mexican cities.

"With this operation, Grupo Comercial Chedraui continues executing its strategic plan of orienting itself toward its main business of self-service stores and accerlerate its program of growth," Alfredo Chedraui, chairman of the Chedraui board, said in the Liverpool statement.
